IX. Quæ sequuntur prædicamenta, sunt
secundaria. Exiis Quando est notatio temporis: Vbi est
notatio loci: Situs est circumstantia positionis corporum:
Habitus est circumstantia vestitus. Exempla primi prædi-
camenti sunt Psalm. 106: secundi, Num. 34: tertii, Num. 33.
Exod. 37. & 38. quarti, Exod. 28.
LX.
COLLATIO LOGICÆ CVM
GRAMMATICA EX S. LI-
TERIS.
I. COllatio Logicæ cum Grammaticâ ex
sacris literis monstrat exempla, in qui-
bus verba sunt indicia affectionis Logicæ: idq;
in locis inuentionis, axiomate, syllogismo &
methodo.
II. In locis inuentionis affectiones rerum
certis vocabulis exprimuntur. Et principio qui-
dem genitiuus vim suam spargit per omnes fere locos in-
uentionis. Notat enim causam efficientem, vt Matth. 25. v.
34. Marc. 1. v. 24. vel causam finalem, vt Iohan. 17. v. 12. Rom.
8. v. 36. 2. Thess. 2. v. 3. vel materiam, vt Act. 2. v. 3. vel formam,
vt Leuit. 5. v. 21. vel effectum, vt Gen. 35. v. 18. Luc. 1. v. 69. vel
subiectum, vt Gen. 18. v. 21: vel adiunctum, vt Gen. 24. v. 48.
vel totum, vt Leuit. 16. v. 5. vel partitionem, vt Gen. 36. v. 15:
vel speciem, vt Exod. 29. v. 2. &c. Atque hinc dicitur geniti-
uus causæ, effecti, subiecti, obiecti, maiorum, minorum,

page.notes: Printed marginal line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) are transcribed as notes at their lines. Stray marks near "variæ" and beside "IX." are not transcribed. The drop cap "C" of "Collatio" is joined to the word. "Ecclesiam.Eph.5." is read from a slightly broken line where the long s and the hyphenated word are hard to separate, so the reading is doubtful. "Exiis" is doubtful and is kept as printed.
